description.p: Opening Tree Builder (OTB) lets you build and keep your chess opening repertoire offline, in a single Polyglot book file that other chess programs and engines can use too.

ul.li: View mode to explore your book, build mode to add every move you play
Import games from PGN files, filtered by player and color
One book per color: White, Black or both
Transpositions are detected and every move order can be shown
Engine evaluation with the built-in Stockfish
Autoplay through a line, piece animation, board coordinates

screenshot.caption: The board with the book moves and the current line

description.p: Stockfish is built in, so engine evaluation works without any setup. Arrows and circles can be drawn on the board with the right mouse button, the book folder is a setting, and OTB is now available for Linux as a Snap and a Flatpak.
Book colors, a New Book dialog, PGN import filtered by player and color, much faster handling of big books, piece animation, autoplay and a board in the Lichess look.
